title: WGP-ABF Standard Part Descriptor v0.5
description: A machine-readable descriptor for a standard ABIR part. partKind preserves the six ABIR object categories. I0-I4 records controlled interchangeability and is independent from F3-F0 structural provenance.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON with this root contentHash member omitted.

partKind.description: Direct lowercase mapping to the six ABIR object categories.

registryRecord.description: One immutable record in an append-only registry log. Revocation and tombstone are new records; they never rewrite an earlier publication.

recordHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON with this root recordHash member omitted.

interchangeabilityLevel.description: Controlled interchangeability only. I4 requires executed migration, acceptance, and rollback evidence and never implies hot reload. F3-F0 values belong only to structuralProvenance.

compatibilityEnvironment.description: An immutable target environment identity used by directed compatibility assessments.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON with this root contentHash member omitted.

compatibilityProfile.description: A stable, reusable compatibility context and policy. It does not assert an I-level for any part pair.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON with this root contentHash member omitted.

testVector.description: A test definition. It is not evidence that the test has run or passed.

conformanceSuite.description: Versioned test definitions only; execution outcomes belong in conformanceReport.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON with this root contentHash member omitted.

conformanceReport.description: An immutable executed-suite report. External EvidenceStatusRecord entries determine whether it is currently admissible; suite definitions alone are never evidence.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON with this root contentHash member omitted.

replacementPlan.description: A controlled replacement linked to one guarded RecipeDiff. replacementMode independently selects restart, rolling, hot-reload, offline, or manual execution; I4 never selects a mode implicitly.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON with this root contentHash member omitted.

interchangeabilityAssessment.description: A directed, time-bounded A-to-B interchangeability result under one exact profile and environment. It is evidence, not a reusable rule template.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON with this root contentHash member omitted.

levelEvidence.description: Exact executed-report references assigned to each cumulative interchangeability level. I0 carries no report evidence; I1-I4 are evaluated in order.

evidenceStatusRecord.description: One immutable entry in an append-only status chain for an exact ConformanceReport. Revocation and tombstone append records and never mutate the report.
